references.title: Sadr, Jarudi & Sinha (2003) · The Role of Eyebrows in Face Recognition
references.notes: Familiar-face recognition was disrupted by eyebrow removal, more than by eye removal in this experiment. Supports the importance of eyebrows to recognition; does not test this subject or prove that higher brows are better.

references.title: Hill & Bruce (1996) · Effects of lighting on the perception of facial surfaces
references.notes: Primary face-perception study; abstract reviewed. Supports separating illumination from facial-surface interpretation, not predicting an individual’s attractiveness.
